name: Website Disable Add To Cart Button Guest Users
description:
Disable Add to Cart for Guest - Restrict Cart Access for Public Users in Odoo Website

        This Odoo module disables the "Add to Cart" functionality for public or guest users on your eCommerce website.
        While guests can browse products, view details, compare items, and add to wishlist, they are restricted from adding any product to the cart
        unless they are logged in. Ideal for B2B websites, wholesale portals, and exclusive membership platforms.

        Features:
        - Restrict Add to Cart for guest (non-authenticated) users
        - Logged-in users enjoy full shopping features (cart, wishlist, compare)
        - Guest users can still view, compare, and wishlist products
        - Encourages user registration/login to enable checkout
        - Enhances user flow for account-based sales strategies
        - Seamless integration with Odoo website_sale module
        - Easy to manage and configure

        Navigation:
        Website > Shop > Product Page / Compare / Wishlist

name: Website Product and Category Visibility for Customer and Guest Users
description:
The Odoo Website Product and Category Visibility module (compatible with Odoo V11 to V18) allows admins to manage the visibility of products and categories for both guest users and registered customers. This module provides full control over what different types of users can see on the website, ensuring a customized browsing experience.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Guest User Product and Category Visibility:**  
       - Admins can define which products and categories are visible to guest users.  

    2) **Registered Customer Product and Category Visibility:**  
       - Control product and category access for logged-in customers based on user-specific configurations.  

    3) **Dynamic Website Filtering:**  
       - Adjust product listings dynamically depending on the user type.  

    4) **B2B and Membership-Based Access Control:**  
       - Restrict product visibility based on user roles, membership levels, or customer groups.  

    5) **Secure Online Shopping Experience:**  
       - Prevent unauthorized access to restricted products and categories.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Exclusive B2B Products:** Hide wholesale products from retail customers.  
    - **Membership-Based Stores:** Display premium products only to subscribed members.  
    - **Guest User Restrictions:** Limit the visibility of certain products to logged-in customers only.  
    - **Role-Based Shopping:** Show different product categories to different customer groups.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Configuration → Public Guest Visibility  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Configuration → Registered Customer Visibility  
    - **Navigation:** Website → Ecommerce → Products
summary: The Odoo Website Product and Category Visibility module enables administrators to control product and category visibility for both guest users and registered customers. This functionality ensures that only authorized users can access specific products and categories, allowing for a customized browsing experience. With this module, admins can restrict or allow product visibility based on user type, offering a more personalized and secure online store experience. name: Access Based Survey Questions
description:
The Odoo Access-Based Survey Questions module (compatible with Odoo V11 to V18) helps businesses and organizations manage survey questions based on user access rights. This module allows admins to assign survey questions to specific access groups, ensuring that only authorized users can view and respond to designated questions within a single survey.  

    **Key Features:**  
    1) **Access-Based Survey Question Visibility:**  
       - Assign survey questions to specific user groups, ensuring targeted data collection.  

    2) **Multi-Group Question Control:**  
       - Admins can assign multiple groups to different survey questions, restricting access accordingly.  

    3) **Role-Based Survey Participation:**  
       - Users see only the survey questions permitted for their assigned access groups.  

    4) **Centralized Survey Management:**  
       - Maintain different question sets for various access groups within a single survey.  

    5) **Enhanced Data Security:**  
       - Prevent unauthorized users from accessing or responding to restricted questions.  

    **Use Cases:**  
    - **Employee Surveys:** Provide different departments access to specific survey questions.  
    - **Customer Feedback Forms:** Show different survey sections to various customer segments.  
    - **Educational Assessments:** Display distinct questions for different student levels or classes.  
    - **HR Evaluations:** Control access to survey questions based on job roles and departments.  

    **Supported Views:**  
    - **Navigation:** Settings → Users & Companies → Users  
    - **Navigation:** Survey → Questions  
    - **Navigation:** Survey → Surveys
summary: The Odoo Access-Based Survey Questions module allows businesses to control survey question visibility based on user access groups. This feature ensures that different user groups can access specific questions within a single survey, enabling targeted data collection and better role-based participation. With this module, administrators can assign survey questions to multiple access groups, ensuring customized question visibility per user role.
